reason: Relay before the single-start guard: `launchctl submit` restarts the job after every exit, so a command longer than launchd's 10 s throttle started again as soon as it ended, truncating its out/err before the relay read them (integration run 2026-11-16: test_agent_ci_shards CiGateTests lost its unittest summary, rc 0) and rerunning it until the label was removed.
